goal: Review an equipment loan request and decide whether it can join the collection queue or needs the desk manager’s decision. Record the review status and reason.

input_fields.description: The type of the borrower requesting the loan, typically EMPLOYEE or CONTRACTOR.
input_fields.label: Borrower Type

input_fields.description: The number of days requested for the equipment loan.
input_fields.label: Requested Loan Days

input_fields.description: Checkbox indicating if the requested equipment is available.
input_fields.label: Equipment Available

input_fields.description: Checkbox indicating if the loan sponsor has confirmed the request.
input_fields.label: Sponsor Confirmed

source_refs.quote: An EMPLOYEE request may be marked READY_FOR_COLLECTION when requested loan days are from 1 to 5 inclusive, equipment available is Yes, and sponsor confirmed is Yes.

rules.statement: An EMPLOYEE request may be marked READY_FOR_COLLECTION when requested loan days are from 1 to 5 inclusive, equipment available is Yes, and sponsor confirmed is Yes.

source_refs.quote: A request for more than 5 days requires the desk manager's decision and must remain HELD, even when equipment is available and the sponsor has confirmed.

rules.statement: A request for more than 5 days requires the desk manager's decision and must remain HELD.

source_refs.quote: If a required value is missing, a checkbox is No, the borrower type is unknown, or requested loan days are less than 1, keep the request HELD

rules.statement: If requested loan days are less than 1, keep the request HELD.
